name: Rangarr
description: Rangarr is a lightweight orchestration service that automates and staggers media searches across multiple *arr instances (Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr). It helps keep your library complete without overwhelming your indexers or API limits. Features: - Multi-Instance Support: Manage Radarr, Sonarr, and Lidarr from a single service. - Smart Staggering: Prevents "thundering herd" issues by spacing out search requests. - Proportional Interleaving: Balanced searching between missing items and upgrades. - Weighted Distribution: Prioritize specific instances. - No Telemetry: Only communicates with the *arr instances you configure. Note: By default, this template is configured using environment variables. You can also use a config.yaml by mapping the /app/config path and changing RANGARR_CONFIG_SOURCE to "file".

paths.name: AppData Config Path
paths.description: Mount point for config.yaml (only needed if RANGARR_CONFIG_SOURCE is 'file').

variables.name: Config Source
variables.description: Set to 'env' to use environment variables or 'file' to use a config.yaml mount.

variables.name: Run Interval (Seconds)
variables.description: How often to run the search cycle (e.g., 3600 for every hour).

variables.name: Dry Run
variables.description: If true, Rangarr will log what it would search without actually triggering the search.

variables.name: Stagger Interval (Seconds)
variables.description: Seconds to wait between individual search requests.

variables.name: Missing Batch Size
variables.description: Max missing items to search per cycle (0 = disabled, -1 = unlimited).

variables.name: Upgrade Batch Size
variables.description: Max upgrade-eligible items to search per cycle (0 = disabled, -1 = unlimited).

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Set your timezone for log timestamps.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Set the log level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

variables.name: Search Order
variables.description: Priority for choosing items (alphabetical_ascending, alphabetical_descending, last_added_ascending, last_added_descending, last_searched_ascending, last_searched_descending, random, release_date_ascending, release_date_descending).

variables.name: Search Retry Interval (Days)
variables.description: Days to wait before searching the same item again (0 to disable).

variables.name: Include Tags
variables.description: Comma-separated list of *arr tag names to include. Only items with at least one matching tag will be searched. Leave blank to include all items.

variables.name: Exclude Tags
variables.description: Comma-separated list of *arr tag names to exclude. Items with any matching tag will be skipped. Leave blank to exclude nothing.

variables.name: Radarr: Name
variables.description: Display name for this instance.

variables.name: Radarr: Type
variables.description: Must be 'radarr'.

variables.name: Radarr: URL
variables.description: URL to your Radarr instance (use Docker IP or hostname).

variables.name: Radarr: API Key
variables.description: Your Radarr API Key.

variables.name: Sonarr: Name
variables.description: Display name for this instance.

variables.name: Sonarr: Type
variables.description: Must be 'sonarr'.

variables.name: Sonarr: URL
variables.description: URL to your Sonarr instance (use Docker IP or hostname).

variables.name: Sonarr: API Key
variables.description: Your Sonarr API Key.

variables.name: Sonarr: Search Season Packs
variables.description: If true, Sonarr will search for missing/upgrade items as season packs when multiple episodes are needed.

variables.name: Lidarr: Name
variables.description: Display name for this instance.

variables.name: Lidarr: Type
variables.description: Must be 'lidarr'.

variables.name: Lidarr: URL
variables.description: URL to your Lidarr instance (use Docker IP or hostname).

variables.name: Lidarr: API Key
variables.description: Your Lidarr API Key.
